## Files changed
Only the two allowed paths: `main.go` and `main_test.go`. No other files touched, no dependencies added, no git commands run.

## What I added

**`main.go`**
- `orderStatuses` (`PENDING_REVIEW`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`) and a `validOrderStatus` helper that matches exactly (no trimming/case-folding, so the filter compares against the stored value).
- `listOrders` now reads the `status` query parameter:
  - absent → every order, unchanged behaviour (unrelated query params don't trigger the filter);
  - present and valid → only orders whose `Status` equals it, still with their `evidence` array;
  - present and anything else (incl. empty, lowercase, padded) → `400` with `{"error":"status must be PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED"}`.

**`main_test.go`** — three tests plus two small helpers (`listOrders`, `reviewOrder`), reusing the existing `decodeError` helper:
- `TestListOrdersFiltersByStatus` — each of the three statuses returns only matching orders (empty JSON array when none), and re-reviewing an order moves it between filters.
- `TestListOrdersWithoutStatusReturnsAll` — no parameter returns all orders across mixed statuses; `?page=1` does not filter.
- `TestListOrdersRejectsUnknownStatus` — `SHIPPED`, `pending_review`, `%20APPROVED`, and empty `status=` all get 400 with a JSON error naming `status`.

- `gofmt -l main.go main_test.go` → no output (both files already formatted)
- `go vet ./...` → clean, no findings
- `go test ./... -v -run 'TestListOrders|TestHealthAndOrderList|TestEvidenceIsListedWithTheOrder'` → all 5 PASS
- `go test ./...` → `ok  example.com/order-operations-portal  0.232s`
